summary: The pass that checks claims against sources ran out of room before it finished checking, and reported that as being unable to reach the model.
details: Checking one claim takes the model several rounds of searching. It was allowed ten, and measurement shows it finishes somewhere between nine and fifteen — so most of the time it was cut off mid-check.

Being cut off did not look like being cut off. The half-finished answer was unreadable, so the pass reported 'I could not reach the model', which also holds its place in the conversation history — meaning the same messages were checked again next time, and cut off again.
It now has room to finish. Two other limits on the same pass are unchanged, so it is still bounded by time and by size rather than allowed to run indefinitely.
limitations: This buys room; it does not make the pass self-limiting. The instructions never say how much research is enough, so the model stops when it is satisfied rather than when it has done a stated amount — and if it becomes less decisive, this ceiling is what will be hit again.
